args.title: Freight Pricing Summary – Juniper Blog + Companion (2026)
args.body:
- Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter, while contract rates stayed the same.
- Fuel surcharges now follow weekly diesel prices.
- Companion piece: shippers who split their volume across three carriers paid the least.

Sources: https://blog.juniper.example/2026/freight ; https://insights.juniper.example/freight/companion
